parameters.query:
SELECT 
  id::text AS lead_id,
  nome,
  COALESCE(empresa, metadata->>'companyName', 'cliente') AS empresa,
  telefone,
  email,
  servico,
  metadata,
  status,
  COALESCE(followup_count, 0) AS followup_count,
  created_at AS lead_created_at,
  last_response_at
FROM public.leads_site
WHERE status IN ('whatsapp_enviado', 'recebido')
  AND COALESCE(followup_count, 0) < 2
  AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  AND (
    last_response_at IS NULL 
    OR last_response_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  )
ORDER BY created_at ASC
LIMIT 50;

parameters.query:
UPDATE public.leads_site 
SET 
  followup_count = COALESCE(followup_count, 0) + 1,
  last_followup_at = NOW(),
  status = CASE 
    WHEN COALESCE(followup_count, 0) + 1 >= 2 THEN 'frio'
    ELSE status
  END,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1::bigint;
